title: One new LA event role, and your favorites are all still open
intro: One new LA role turned up: a private-events sales job at Fairmont's luxury Breakers hotel in Long Beach (Accor). I also re-ranked your picks using your Nov 1 notes, so the client, partnership, experiential, and beauty-house roles you liked are at the top, and the social-media and creator roles sit lower.
notes: Today's search covered SMCP, CHANEL, L'Oréal, Dior, Hermès, Cartier, Louis Vuitton, Sephora, Clarins, Danone, Pernod Ricard, Moët Hennessy, Kering, Accor, Ipsos, Teads, Publicis Groupe agencies, Havas, and LinkedIn listings across LA County.
SMCP Group: the 61 US and Canada openings are still boutique and store roles (plus a Montreal retail brand manager), with no marketing roles.

Also seen but not numbered: L-Acoustics Business Development Manager, Concert Venues (Westlake Village; asks 10+ years), Ipsos Director, Client Success (Culver City; research operations, 6+ years), and CHANEL visual merchandising and boutique roles (retail).

jobs.title: Specialist, Client Management
jobs.french_tie: Influential is a creator-marketing company owned by Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: The account-management side of influencer marketing, so it's the closest match to what you do now. You'd be the day-to-day contact for brand clients in beauty, CPG, retail, and more: joining campaign kickoffs, keeping timelines and budgets on track, solving problems as they come up, reporting on results, and building relationships with senior clients. It asks for 3–5 years, which lines up with your Gartner years.
jobs.stretch_note: A mild stretch: it wants that experience in a digital or advertising setting, ideally agency account management, and yours is B2B research sales. It's brand new (listed Oct 30), so applying early helps.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1).

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Talent & Partnerships
jobs.french_tie: 160over90 is part of Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.travel: The posting asks for the ability to travel as needed (no destinations named).
jobs.why: Listed again after it closed on Oct 9, and it's the closest fit in LA. You'd help run a major global brand's athlete and talent partnerships across markets: vetting talent, helping with negotiations and contracts, managing agreements, and coordinating appearances and big global events. It asks for about 3–5 years in account management or partnerships, which matches your Gartner years, contract negotiations, and executive-facing work.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1). Heads-up: the posting says 4 days a week in office.

jobs.title: Account Supervisor, Experiential
jobs.french_tie: Team One is part of Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.travel: Up to 25% travel within the Western US, plus some nights and weekends for live events (no international travel mentioned).
jobs.why: A partnerships-heavy role: you'd run Lexus's Western-region experiential programs and partnerships (sports marketing, culinary, music, performing arts, and auto events), keep partners delivering on sponsorship benefits, and present strategy and results to Lexus clients. Your Gartner client management and executive presentations line up well with the client side of the job.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 5–7 years of event- or sports-marketing experience.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1). Applications close around Nov 30.

jobs.title: Fragrance & Beauty Account Executive, Los Angeles
jobs.travel: The posting lists 25–30% travel; it doesn't say international.
jobs.why: Still open on CHANEL's careers site. It's a brand-side account role at a French luxury house: you'd run promotional programs with retail partners, where your AE skills carry straight over. It leans more toward sales than marketing.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1).

jobs.title: Manager, US Marketing (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); NYX Professional Makeup is in L'Oréal's Consumer Products Division.
jobs.why: Still the best brand-side marketing job in LA. You'd run US go-to-market for launches and 360 campaigns, work with the global marketing team to adapt campaigns for the US, brief creators and agencies, and manage budgets.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years of brand marketing in beauty, CPG, or retail (beauty strongly preferred).

jobs.title: Specialist, Creator Management
jobs.french_tie: Influential is a creator-marketing company owned by Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: A partnerships job at your level: you'd find and vet creators for Fortune 500 brand campaigns, negotiate and contract with them, and manage the campaigns day to day, working with the account, analytics, and operations teams. Your negotiating, relationship-building, and presenting skills from Gartner carry over directly.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in digital, advertising, or creator marketing. Your years fit, but they're in B2B account management. Also, the posting says it expected applications to close Oct 19, but it's still listed, so apply soon.
jobs.status: You asked for a tailored resume (sent Nov 1).

jobs.title: Private Event Sales Manager, Outlets
jobs.work_arrangement: Not stated; the duties (property tours, hosting client mixers, working events) are on site at the hotel
jobs.french_tie: Fairmont is an Accor brand (Paris HQ), and Accor runs this hotel under a management contract.
jobs.why: An event and culinary role at Long Beach's new luxury hotel, the restored Breakers (rooftop Sky Room, a jazz club, Italian restaurant Nettuno). You'd sell and run private dinners and events in its restaurants and bars for corporate and social clients: prospecting, giving tours to event planners, hosting client mixers, negotiating contracts, and seeing each event through. It builds directly on your AE skills (pipeline, negotiation, relationships), and it's closer to the music-and-culinary experiential side you liked in #57 than to social media.
jobs.stretch_note: It's still a sales role, and it asks for 2+ years of event sales at a luxury hotel or restaurant plus Opera Cloud (hotel sales software), which you don't have yet.

jobs.title: Manager, Client Management
jobs.french_tie: Influential is a creator-marketing company owned by Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: The step above #58 on the same team: you'd run day-to-day communication with brand clients and their agencies, oversee campaign delivery, spot chances to grow existing accounts, and coach the specialists. Growing accounts and client relationships are things you already do at Gartner.
jobs.stretch_note: A real stretch: it asks for 5–7 years in client service or account management in media, marketing, or influencer work, plus a working knowledge of influencer and branded-content campaigns.

jobs.title: Sales & Education Executive, Blended (Los Angeles)
jobs.french_tie: Groupe Clarins is a family-owned French beauty group (Paris).
jobs.why: Still listed. You'd cover Clarins at Sephora, Ulta, and department stores across an LA territory: training store teams, running in-store events, carrying out marketing and merchandising plans, and sending weekly performance recaps. It's a field role at a French beauty group and could be a stepping stone to brand roles.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years of in-store beauty sales experience, and it's more retail sales and education than marketing.

jobs.title: Associate Producer, Social Media
jobs.french_tie: Team One is Publicis Groupe's luxury-focused agency (Paris HQ). Its clients include Lexus, The Ritz-Carlton, and Moët Hennessy.
jobs.why: An entry-level way into a luxury-brand agency in LA. You'd keep Lexus social video projects (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) on schedule from shoot to finish: calendars, estimates, vendors, and client communication. The coordination side fits your organized, client-facing AE habits, and you produced and promoted a podcast during your Windward internship.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 1–2 years of production experience focused on social media, ideally at an ad or social agency. This is more production than marketing.
